messages:
alex: FYI — planning kernel ABI bump + q8-matmul-v2 quant bundle deploy during nightly change window TOMORROW 02:00-04:00 PDT. Phased canary: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m observation between slices. Need pins for critical regions (us-east-1, eu-west-1) and a 2h TTL pin for high-SLA customers. If latency SLO regression >2x or error rate >0.5% -> rollback. Who can own pins/unpins and post-deploy telemetry?

mira: @alex can we wire automatic fallback to matmul-v1 for any runtime errors? would like an opt-in route so customer-facing traffic keeps going if q8 kernel throws.

sam: overlap check — eng-infra has infra-sec patch scheduled same night at 01:30. can we shift start to 03:00 to avoid deployment window clash? last time overlapping patches spiked alert noise.

cheng: I can own postdeploy telemetry and alerts. smoke checklist (short):
```
1) pin canary traffic: `deploybot pin engine:kernel:q8-matmul-v2 --region us-east-1 --percent 1 --ttl 30m`
2) run `./scripts/run_smoke.sh --subset=canary --checks=latency,errors,kv-cache`
3) validate KV cache hits and KV cache memory pressure < 70%
4) sanity-run generation on the canary promptset (in /infra/evals/canary/quant)
```
I'll push dashboards and alerts before rollout.

deploy-bot: Deployment request created by alex — scheduled window 2026-03-25 03:00 PDT. CI: green. Canaries: enabled. ID: dbot-2164000000.

karen: heads-up from support: free-tier customers in eu-west-1 had a regression during the matmul-v2 alpha last quarter. please add eu-west-1 holdback by default and include a note in release notes so support can triage if needed.

alex: decision: start at 03:00 PDT. canary slices adjusted to 1/5/20/100 (shortened 25->20 to reduce blast radius). eu-west-1 will be held back by default; we'll pin it to `kernel:matmul-v1` for the first 2 hours. high-sla customers (identified in infra/tickets/tagged-slo) get a 2h explicit pin. rollback criteria copied here: "p95 token latency > 2x baseline OR error rate > 0.5% (5xxs or inference failures) OR KV cache miss surge > 10%". If triggered, immediate rollback and notify #incidents.

sam: ack. I'll coordinate with infra to avoid the other patch. moving start to 03:00 works for ops.

mira: I'll implement fallback routing: on runtime error, route to `kernel:matmul-v1` for that request path and emit a `fallback_to_legacy` metric. Also will add an eval job for the canary promptset to run automatically at each slice.

cheng: prepping rollback commands and smoke runbook now. putting these in the deploy ticket:
```
# force rollback to v1 in region
deploybot pin engine:kernel:matmul-v1 --region eu-west-1 --percent 100 --reason "rollback - perf/regression"
# global emergency rollback
deploybot emergency-rollback engine:kernel:matmul-v1 --all-regions --notify #incidents
```
I'll also set an alert that posts to #eng-oncall with stacktraces and sample prompts when `fallback_to_legacy` > 5/min.

deploy-bot: deploy dbot-2164000000 updated: start=2026-03-25T03:00:00-07:00, canary_slices=[1,5,20,100], regions=us-east-1,ap-northeast-1 (eu-west-1 held back).

karen: sounds good — support will prepare a short support note: bullet list of expected behavior and how to trigger a manual rollback for a customer. please attach to the release ticket.

alex: thanks everyone. action items:
- mira: fallback routing + canary evals (owner)
- cheng: dashboards, alerts, rollback commands (owner)
- sam: coordinate infra timing and ops coverage (owner)
- karen: draft support-facing release note (owner)
I'll post final release notes + deployment ticket link 2h before the window. :thumbsup:

mira: ack. I'll drop the eval job link once it's green.

sam: ack. ops oncall coverage confirmed 02:45-05:00 PDT.

cheng: putting staging run results in the ticket now, all green locally. will stand by during window.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled 2026-03-25T02:30:00-07:00 -> post deploy checklist will be posted to the ticket.
